transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Lee. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi Dr. Lee. Well, I came in today because... I know this sounds a bit hard to explain, but I’ve been completely convinced lately that one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me. It's like certain comments they make in class, or even just regular Slack messages, are actually coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. I just thought I should probably talk to someone about it.
How long have you been experiencing these beliefs that your classmate and advisor are sending you coded signals?
It's been going on for about two months now. I guess it really started around the time I began the part-time MBA prerequisite program, while still working my regular operations job.

Over these past two months, have you also noticed changes in your mood—like feeling unusually elevated, energetic, and needing less sleep, or on the other end, feeling very down, hopeless, or losing interest in things?

Well, yeah, mostly I've just felt really... switched on. Like, unusually optimistic. Most days it feels like I'm right on the edge of something huge happening for me. But at the same time, I've been getting frustrated really easily. I find myself snapping at my coworkers or my boyfriend over tiny delays that wouldn't normally bother me at all.
Have you been using any alcohol, drugs, or stimulants—like caffeine pills, ADHD medications, or anything else—more than usual during this time?

No, not really. I mean, I drink coffee in the mornings, but just my normal amount. I haven't been drinking alcohol or taking any drugs, and I don't use any ADHD medications or caffeine pills or anything like that. Just my regular routine.

Are these beliefs about coded messages from your classmate and advisor present all the time, or do they seem to become more intense specifically during the periods when you're feeling unusually optimistic and energetic?

I'd say they are definitely connected. Before this whole stretch of being so energized and driven, I never had messages feel coded like this to me. And I never heard my name being called when no one was actually there, either. Those experiences really only started happening once my mood shifted and my workload got so intense right after I began the MBA prerequisites.
Before these past two months, have you ever had another period—lasting a week or more—where you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable, or conversely, deeply depressed or hopeless?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had times where I felt happy or stressed, but nothing like this. This past couple of months is really the first time I've felt this... intense, I guess. So, no, nothing like this before.

Thinking back over your life, have you ever gone through a stretch of at least two weeks where you felt unusually sad, low on energy, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy—even if it wasn't severe enough to seek help at the time?

No, I really haven't. I mean, sure, I've had a bad day here and there, or felt stressed out about work or school, but never anything that lasted for two weeks. I've never felt like I couldn't get out of bed or lost interest in my normal life. It's really just been this recent period where everything feels so... amplified. But no long stretches of being sad or depressed, no.
